finding: The holdout block in that run card (HOLDOUT-DTI gems73-holdout-v1, mean 0.1112, CI [0.0937, 0.1280], 12,226 withheld positives) was produced by src/gems73/holdout.py, whose evaluate_holdout() returned hard-coded synthetic-demo constants whenever data/ was absent. No catalogue pixel was ever withheld or scored to produce those numbers; the card's own controls note says 'Synthetic Walker Lane population'. The 'promote' verdict in that card therefore rests on numbers that are not measurements and is VOID.
